vatTreatmentBasis: Each record keeps the VAT basis of the retrieved source. A source that does not state VAT treatment is recorded as VAT_EXCLUDED only when the publisher presents business/wholesale tariffs; otherwise VAT_UNKNOWN is used and the record is not used in a VAT-inclusive total. Non-EUR tariffs keep their native currency here; conversion to EUR is performed only in recurring-cost-inputs.json with the explicit ECB euro reference rate recorded there. No formal quotation or executed contract exists for any provider below; FORMAL_PROVIDER_QUOTATION and EXECUTED_CONTRACT are intentionally absent.

fxRates.sourceTitle: ECB euro reference exchange rates (2 November 2026)
fxRates.notes: ECB page states 2 November 2026 and USD spot 1.1216 USD per EUR; EUR-per-USD = 1 / 1.1216 = 0.8915834, rounded to 0.8916. Basis: EUR base, USD quoted.

summary.statement: No connectivity, cloud, notification, payment or app-distribution contract exists for MAREA. Every figure above is a public list price or a declared engineering assumption; none is a production entitlement, SLA or guaranteed price.
